theme_and_archetype.primary_vibe: Premium Admin Dashboard with Amber Orange Accents (Purple Admin template inspired)

primary_gradient.description: Used for active sidebar items, primary buttons, and gradient stat cards

typography.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Use Outfit for a premium, structured admin feel.

sidebar.mobile_behavior: hidden md:flex off-canvas drawer on mobile
sidebar.profile_block: Flex column, p-6, border-b border-border. Avatar rounded-full h-16 w-16 mb-3 ring-2 ring-primary/20. Name bold text-foreground, role text-sm text-muted-foreground. Small absolute dot indicator for online status.
sidebar.nav_items: Rounded-lg mx-3 my-1 px-4 py-3 flex items-center gap-3 transition-colors. Inactive: hover:bg-orange-50 dark:hover:bg-orange-500/10 hover:text-orange-500. Active: bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-400 to-orange-500 text-white shadow-md shadow-orange-500/20.
sidebar.icons: Phosphor Icons (size 20 or 24, duotone for active, regular for inactive)

header.layout: Sticky top-0 z-40 w-full backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b border-border px-6 flex items-center justify-between
header.search: Relative, w-64 md:w-96. Icon absolute left 3, input rounded-full bg-muted border-none pl-10 focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-primary
header.actions: Flex gap-4 items-center. Theme toggle, Currency Switch (USD/INR dropdown), Notification bell (relative with absolute top-0 right-0 h-2 w-2 bg-orange-500 rounded-full ring-2 ring-background), User menu dropdown.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Use 'Bento' grid variants for dashboards. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 for stat cards. gap-6.

variants.name: Gradient Accent
variants.style: bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-400 to-orange-500 text-white rounded-2xl p-6 relative overflow-hidden shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/20
variants.elements: Large amount text-3xl font-bold, subtle transparent icon (opacity-20) absolute -right-4 -bottom-4 h-32 w-32

variants.name: Standard Admin
variants.style: bg-card text-card-foreground rounded-2xl p-6 border border-border shadow-sm
variants.elements: Orange icon container (bg-orange-50 dark:bg-orange-500/10 text-orange-500 rounded-xl p-3), Title text-muted-foreground, Value text-3xl font-bold

cards.general: rounded-2xl border border-border shadow-sm bg-card overflow-hidden
cards.header: px-6 py-5 border-b border-border flex items-center justify-between bg-card/50

tables.header: text-xs uppercase bg-muted/50 text-muted-foreground py-3 px-4 font-medium tracking-wider

badges.income: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800
badges.expense: bg-rose-50 text-rose-600 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:text-rose-400 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800
badges.pending: bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-400 to-orange-500 hover:from-amber-500 hover:to-orange-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-orange-500/20 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5

page_layouts.dashboard_overview: Top: 4 stat cards (Net Worth, Today's Spend, Enrolled, Settle Pending). Middle: Grid 12 - Col span 8 (Revenue/Expense Line Chart), Col span 4 (Expense by Category Donut/List). Bottom: Recent Transactions Table.
page_layouts.transactions_list: Header card with filters (Date range, Account, Category). Table with columns: Date, Description, Category, Account, Amount (colored), Status.
page_layouts.invoices: Advanced Form: Type selector (Campus Visit / Service Charge). Dynamic particulars list linked to expenses. Totals card fixed to right side or bottom. PDF Generation trigger.
page_layouts.students: Grid view of student cards (status-tinted top border). Detail view: Split layout. Left: Info card + add entry dialog trigger. Right: Vertical timeline of scheduled payments vs actual collections.
page_layouts.quick_entry: Large toggle (Debit / Credit) using custom radio cards. Massive keypad-style or large text input for Amount to minimize friction. Select account and category.
page_layouts.auth: Split screen. Left (or right): Massive brand hero panel with subtle orange gradient and 3D floating dashboard illustration or abstract pattern. Other side: Clean, centered login/register form.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle -translate-y-[1px] on interactive cards and primary buttons.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use 'transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out' for color and shadow changes.
motion_and_interactions.theme_toggle: Smooth fade/switch of icons (Sun/Moon Phosphor icons).

testing.requirements: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, dropdowns, table rows) MUST have a data-testid attribute.

icons.rules: Use duotone for active states/large decorative icons, regular/light for inactive or dense tables. Do NOT mix libraries.

implementation_notes.file_extensions: Use .js and .jsx extensions. Do not use .tsx.
implementation_notes.shadcn: Initialize shadcn and apply the custom CSS variables in globals.css. Override default border radius to 0.75rem (xl) or 1rem (2xl) for softer, premium 'Purple Admin' feel.
